messages:
Alex Chen: Quick heads-up — we need to coordinate a per-customer rollout for the new adaptive-priority-routing feature. Goal: contract-gated by default, explicit VIP allowlist, small prod canary, and guardrails (latency/cost/error). Can we confirm approach and owners?

Maria Gomez: Sounds good. Which config store are we using for the allowlist? Are we adding a new flag type or reusing tenant-scoped flags?

Jordan Patel: I'd prefer reusing tenant-scoped flags if possible. Adding a distinct 'contract_gated' boolean per-flag could work. Avoid new plumbing unless we must.

Priya Rao: Guardrails: auto-roll back if 5xx rate increases > 2x baseline or p50 latency regresses > 30%. Also need a fallback model routing to default-priority. Who owns the rollback automation?

Sam Lee: I can wire enforcement in the gateway once we have the allowlist format. Will also add a 403 for non-allowed contract-scoped requests when flag is marked contract-gated.

Alex Chen: Plan I'm proposing:
- Flag: "adaptive-priority-routing" (tenant-scoped)
- Metadata: {"contract_gated": true, "vip_accounts": [<acct_ids>], "canary_pct": 5} stored in feature-flags service
- Canary: 5% random non-VIP prod traffic + explicit enable for listed VIP accounts + allow dev/stage tests
- Telemetry: rollout_source=customer_flag, metric tags: flag_name, contract_id, is_vip
- Rollback triggers: Priya's thresholds + error-rate anomaly detection

Small config example: 
```yaml
flag: adaptive-priority-routing
enabled: false
metadata:
  contract_gated: true
  vip_accounts:
    - acct_112233
    - acct_acme:acme-enterprise
  canary_pct: 5
```

Alex Chen: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/flags/pull/482 (WIP) — adds contract_gated field and vip_accounts array. @Maria Gomez can you review when free?

infra-bot: FYI — feature-flags service supports tenant-scoped keys and per-flag metadata. Contract-level checks exist via contract_id matcher (no runtime change required).

Maria Gomez: On it, will look this afternoon. Quick ask: include a migration plan for existing flags and a DB schema bump changelog.

Jordan Patel: Metrics callouts: please emit metric names: routing.priority.applied, routing.priority.error_count, routing.priority.latency_ms with tags {flag_name, contract_id, is_vip, rollout_bucket}. Add rollout_source tag like Alex suggested.

Priya Rao: Also add a canary experiment id so we can query traces by experiment. If we can attach trace sampling=1.0 for canary buckets that'd be ideal.

Sam Lee: Allowlist enforcement snippet I'll need (example request header we check):
```http
POST /v1/infer
X-Contract-ID: acct_112233
X-Tenant-ID: tenant-42
```
Gateway will verify contract_id vs vip_accounts/contract_gated flag metadata.

Alex Chen: Good call on traces — I'll add rollout_experiment_id and force sample=true for the 5% canary. Also will add a small UI toggle in console for manual VIP enable/disable when CS asks.

deploy-bot: Schedule: canary deploy window tomorrow 09:30-10:30 UTC — config rollout -> 5% -> monitor 30m -> expand if green. Channel for watch: #incident-watch.

Maria Gomez: Reviewing PR now. If schema change is small I can merge tomorrow AM. Will leave comments on migration safety.

Jordan Patel: One more: ensure Dedicated customers (reserved capacity) are treated as VIP by default if contract flag set. Some dedicated customers may want opt-out.

Priya Rao: We should add an explicit "vip_behavior": "treat_as_vip|respect_default" option in metadata to handle that.

Alex Chen: Adding vip_behavior enum and defaulting to treat_as_vip for contract-bound dedicated accounts. Will update PR and add rollback playbook steps.

Sam Lee: I'll stub gateway checks and a feature flag health endpoint for quick sanity: GET /_health/flags?flag=adaptive-priority-routing

Alex Chen: Awesome. Thanks everyone. @Maria please ping when merged and @deploy-bot when ready to flip canary. :thumbsup:

Maria Gomez: Merge done with minor comments addressed. Leaving a follow-up issue for migration audits.

deploy-bot: Canary started at 2026-03-18T09:30:00Z — rollout_pct=5 — experiment_id=exp-APR-2026-0318

Priya Rao: Monitoring looks green so far (10m in). No latency regressions, error rates steady. I'll keep watching and set auto-rollback at threshold.

Jordan Patel: Nice. If anyone sees anomalies, tag the alert channel and escalate to oncall.

Alex Chen: Closing coordination loop — will file a short post-rollout summary in #eng-platform after the 30m check. Thanks all. :party-popper:
